- [b]Presivy[/b] map has been redesigned and scaled to fit 5v5 perfectly

- Changes have been made to game mechanics 

- Fixed collision bugs on Presivy

- Added dynamic lightning

- [b]Prizren[/b] map have been listed for remaster 

- Lag issues have been fixed

- Fixed lightning bugs

- Added new weapon sounds

- Fixed shadows performance usage

- [b]Prizren[/b] map is now bigger to fit 32 players perfectly

- New widgets with animations

- [b]Competitive[/b] mode added to the game

notes.title: Santern Yard Map Overview
notes.notes:
[b][h1]HISTORY[/h1][/b]
Santern Yard map is based on old town roads located in North Albania. Santern Yard during 1994-1996 was occupied by southern terrorists, where its history is quite significant. In early 1994 Santern Yard began to lose its real name where terrorists began bombing key locations in the country. After a few years Santern began to improve again from the rebels who had occupied the city but in fact the rebels began to increase their population and since then Santern is in the hands of the rebels.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/831498982064390174/831663484601106442/Screen2.png?width=1301&height=670[/img]

[b][h3]Matchmaking[/h3][/b]
On [b]Santern Yard[/b] matchmaking is available only for Competitive, Team-Deathmatch and Deathmatch game modes. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/831498982064390174/831663482851819530/Screen3.png?width=1301&height=670[/img]

[b][h3]Optimization[/h3][/b]
The [b]Santern Yard[/b] is well optimized where players can run it with over 90 fps on medium computers. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/831498982064390174/831663482645774387/Screen4.png?width=1301&height=670[/img]

[b][h3]Information[/h3][/b]
[b]War of Kosovo: 2033[/b] is currently on a [b]Beta e1.1[/b] patch and this map took the place on the launch of the game, there will be 4 different maps coming on this patch.  

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/831498982064390174/831663477353218078/Screen1.png?width=1301&height=760[/img]

[b][h3]Techniques[/h3][/b]
Like the other maps in the game, players are divided into two teams: Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists. The Terrorist side must gain control in one of two locations to plant the bomb; these sites are easily accessible to the Counter-Terrorists at the beginning of the round. Every field has it's own layout where players can determine their locations. A, B, short B, long B, short A, short, B, ivy, upstairs, break, swamp, middle, second middle.     

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/831498982064390174/831663475737886780/Screen5.png?width=1301&height=670[/img]
